import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    a = [0] + [int(x) for x in data[1:1 + n]]
    # dp[i]: best strength sum of the first i elements
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        dp[i] = dp[i - 1] + a[i] * i
        if i >= 2:
            dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[i - 2] + a[i] * (i - 1) + a[i - 1] * i)
    print(dp[n])


main()
